title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Anbu and Thenmozhi promote Kanmani's health mix at a supermarket, securing a sale. Rajasekar emerges from his coma and calls Vennila's name, making Kanmani suspicious.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Kalamma challenges Ilamathi to drive her out after she spoils Sidharth's marriage with the minister's daughter. Later, Ilamathi arranges Sidharth and Nalani's wedding night.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
episodeTitle: Vetri Takes a Stand Against Karna
description: Vetri's testimony and evidence prove Abinaya innocent, securing her unconditional bail. Later, Vetri confronts Karna, determined to uncover the truth behind Parvathy's murder.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Poongodi reveals her accidental injury to Senthamizh and asks her not to tell anyone. Her disclosure prompts Rasathi to reveal it at Manjamalai's home, intensifying the conflict.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Suresh supports Mathi as she seeks a new job, while Thangaraj's health fears concern the family. Later, Malar opposes Shruthi and Karthik's marriage, recalling past humiliation.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Kumar shocks Karthikeyan's family by revealing his past marriage to Arasi. They confront Pandian's family, uncovering the hidden truth and ending Karthikeyan's alliance with Arasi.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Nila tells Chozhan not to misjudge Cheran and Karthika over their closeness. Vannathi hides from Pandian as she accompanies Aravind to a restaurant for his birthday treat.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Rohini feels relieved after learning that Muthu and Ravi are marrying Meena and Shruthi. The two couples happily tie the knot and receive heartfelt blessings from Nachiyar.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Rajangam decides to hold Azhagar and Meenatchi's ear-piercing function publicly for both families to celebrate. However, Tamizhselvi firmly opposes it when Malar informs her.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Karikalan asks Aadhavan to reach out to Karthik, suspecting his whereabouts. Later, Karthik and Kasthuri arrive as a married couple, shocking the family.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: With their parents' blessings, Indhira and Murugan enjoy their wedding with dance and music. Later, Indhira enters the mess following traditional rites, praying for family unity.

title: Bigg Boss The Common Man
episodeTitle: The Common Man: A Dance Marathon
description: Teams clash in a high-energy dance marathon! Standout acts, killer moves, and mid-stage prop swaps bring total fun, before votes decide the best and worst performers.
